text: This report seeks City Council authority for the General Manager, Toronto Water, to negotiate, enter into and execute an agreement with the Toronto Transit Commission for the recovery of all City costs associated with the design and construction of structural lining for sanitary sewer SL50048 near St. Clair West Station. The work is related to Toronto Transit Commission fire ventilation system upgrades at St. Clair West Station under the Line One Capacity Enhancement Program. Toronto Transit Commission has proposed a new below-grade structure above a deep sanitary sewer. Toronto Water has no objection to the proposed structure in relation to the existing Toronto Water infrastructure, provided Toronto Transit Commission funds the structural lining and associated work required to protect the sewer asset.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the General Manager, Toronto Water, to negotiate, enter into and execute on behalf of the City an agreement with the Toronto Transit Commission for the recovery of all City costs for the design and construction of structural lining for sanitary sewer SL50048, including engineering, consulting, permitting, tendering, construction, bypass pumping, mobilization, access works, site restoration, inspection, contract administration, applicable taxes, contingency, and close-out costs, on terms and conditions satisfactory to the General Manager, Toronto Water, and in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the General Manager, Toronto Water, to amend, on behalf of the City, the agreement, as required, to address changes, including changes to scope, budget, schedule, milestones,…
